scope: Chinese public social/community posts; image demonstrations and image-making tutorials are separated from video-derived visual concepts.
caveats: Bilibili candidate metrics were upgraded to direct public read-only API verification (code 0 and labeled stat fields). Douyin figures remain search-engine snapshots of primary pages, not live API verification.
Douyin extraction omits metric labels. Store raw ordered counts; do not assert that the first number is a verified like count. Account-wide likes and follower totals are excluded.
Bilibili top-of-page view counts are kept separate from playlist totals. Videos and tutorial views do not prove that an individual still image earned those views.
All English prompts below are newly authored adaptation drafts, not the creator's original prompt and not generation-tested.
Low-signal or metric-missing entries are reserves, not demonstrated viral successes.
No reliable Xiaohongshu original-post metric was obtained. Instagram and TikTok searches did not yield adequate original-post metrics in this research lane.
